title: Clean IP Manager (Cloudflare)
summary: Scans candidate Cloudflare IPs on a config's own port, then rewrites the address inside the share link when the config can really be fronted by Cloudflare: vless, vmess or trojan over ws, httpupgrade, h2, grpc, xhttp or splithttp. Reality, QUIC protocols (hysteria, hysteria2, tuic, naive+quic) and shadowsocks are refused and left untouched. The header shows the detected proxy core.

items.title: Find Clean IP for a Config
items.description: Scans candidate IPs on the port taken from a config's share link and saves the IP you choose. The original domain is pinned as sni (TLS) or host (plaintext) when the link carried neither, so the TLS handshake still matches.
items.usage_tip: Every saved config is listed, including disabled ones. A config that cannot be fronted is reported and keeps its address. After applying you can push the updated config to the active engine, which refreshes the existing node instead of skipping it.

items.title: Show / Edit Candidate IP List
items.description: Prints the candidate file path and its contents so you can edit it manually.
items.usage_tip: The default list is Cloudflare-focused; one IP per line and # starts a comment.

items.title: Show Last Scan Results
items.description: Displays the cached results of the most recent scan sorted by latency.
items.usage_tip: Results are cleared and rebuilt on every new scan.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: Saved configs keep the address they have now.
